description: A minsum-maxmin search finds every best trade-off between two path qualities. The first is the sum of the edge costs, which it minimizes. The second is the *bottleneck*: the smallest capacity of an edge on the path, which it maximizes. The search expands labels (partial paths) in order of cost plus a consistent heuristic, and wider bottlenecks first among equal costs. A label is redundant when an earlier label at its state, or an earlier solution, has a bottleneck at least as wide, so one value per state is enough. The result is the exact Pareto set, and `minsum_maxmin_multi` allows several sums and several bottlenecks.

papers.title: On a special class of bicriterion path problems
